entries.0532ae6d73e7d295: This is a customer analysis tool specialized for Shopify, operated by consolidated subsidiary ECPower Inc. During the current consolidated fiscal year, it became a consolidated subsidiary through a share acquisition and was made a wholly owned subsidiary through a share exchange. Revenue is not separately disclosed.
entries.4b3701e3e6a8ea45: This is an outsourced data feed management service. It supports a wide range of internet media, including numerous advertising media, price comparison sites and job sites, and assists with the preparation work required before placement. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥44 million.
entries.58bcf95afdf5242d: This business provides, through SaaS, tools that let companies ranging from enterprises to SMBs carry out advanced marketing on a self-service basis. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥1,365 million, and 50 employees work in this business. In addition, the advertising placement automation tool 'EC Booster' ended its service during the current consolidated fiscal year.
entries.708489e3a6c25ecc: This is a marketing support service developed by consolidated subsidiary Anagram Inc., specializing in performance-based advertising such as search engine text advertising (listing advertising) and display advertising. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥2,955 million. In June 2022, the data feed advertising management service 'Feedmatic' was transferred from Feedforce Inc. through an absorption-type company split.
entries.8e6a48404ed5b6ff: A holding company providing ad operation agency services and data feed management tools in the fields of digital marketing and E-commerce.
entries.a57e5d9f7c4d6d20: Advertiser companies centered on enterprise companies
entries.a98464d4d7dc8985: This is a social login and LINE message delivery service that uses ID linkage, operated by consolidated subsidiary Social PLUS Inc. For EC operators using Shopify, it is also offered as the Shopify app 'CRM PLUS on LINE'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥928 million.
entries.d71a43aa8768bcdb: This is a data feed integrated management tool operated by consolidated subsidiary Feedforce Inc. It can optimize a company's product data for a variety of media. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥426 million.
entries.d937609fbcff1877: This business mainly targets enterprise companies, providing outsourced operation of performance-based advertising and support for data feed marketing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥2,999 million, and 118 employees work at the headquarters of consolidated subsidiary Anagram Inc. in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo and at other locations.
entries.ddbf1f7d3f6a249d: Companies ranging from enterprises to SMBs
entries.e54673b87feab779: This is a service operated by consolidated subsidiary Shippino Inc. that automates shipping-related operations for EC operators. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥100 million.
